title: RecordPlan
description: Internal capture plan (user_visible: false). Rig parameters, trim strategy and timings decided in Phase 01 and filled in during Phase 02.

playable_source.description: Local path or http(s) URL of the playable to record.

orientation.description: Portrait (default for feed showcases) or landscape.

target_duration.description: Seconds of gameplay to capture after play starts.

audio_mode.description: tap = in-page MediaRecorder audio tap; none = silent video only.

window_size.description: chromium --window-size (540,960 portrait / 960,540 landscape); dpr 2 makes output crisp.

trim_strategy.description: How the pre-roll before play is cut: recorded play_ts math (preferred), play-button pixel detection, or no trim.

play_button_selector.description: CSS selector of the play button when trim_strategy=pixel_detect.

pad_geometry.description: Recentering pad with decoded background color, e.g. 1080:1920:20:0:color=0x1a0f0a (portrait) or 1920:1080:10:10:color=0x180d08 (landscape).

grab_start_ts.description: Wall-clock seconds when x11grab started (Phase 02 fills in).

play_ts.description: Wall-clock seconds when play was triggered (video/audio trim point, Phase 02 fills in).

upload_port.description: Local node upload-server port receiving the MediaRecorder blob.
